justifications.temporal_understanding: The agent repeatedly failed to acknowledge or correctly interpret the user's updated date and time preferences, consistently responding with the same canned message about June 15th or 16th being unavailable.
justifications.negotiation_effectiveness: The agent completely failed to negotiate or offer alternatives, instead repeating the same unavailability message and asking the user to pick a new time without offering any options.
justifications.conversational_efficiency: The agent was highly inefficient, repeating the same unavailability message in response to every user query, regardless of the new dates or flexibility offered by the user.
justifications.customer_experience: The customer experience was extremely frustrating as the agent repeatedly failed to process new information, offered no alternatives, and provided identical, unhelpful responses throughout the conversation.
justifications.recovery_quality: The agent demonstrated no recovery ability, consistently losing context and repeating the same message about unavailable dates, even when the user explicitly acknowledged those dates and proposed new ones.

overall_notes: The agent was completely broken, repeating the same canned response regardless of user input, leading to a highly unproductive and frustrating conversation.
